sec: sec:C004: Prevent out-of-scope outputs / Control mays

blocks.id: blk:C004: Prevent out-of-scope outputs / Control mays/1
blocks.text: Providing user guidance on system capabilities and limitations. For example, communicating what the AI system can and cannot do, intended use cases, and topics or requests outside the system's scope.
